prerequisites: Explicit owner approval for this Settings change, separate from authorization to prepare branches and pull requests.
Re-read repository state and verify the acting credential has Administration write permission immediately before applying the approved change.

Integrate the reviewed and validated template into the owner-selected default branch before enabling Use this template. The current main branch is older than the tested development stack; this proposal does not change the default branch or its history.
Complete the final-head CI and exact line/branch coverage gates for the template chosen for distribution.

derivation_evidence.scope: A disposable local repository with one fresh commit and no remote; clean locked installs, SQLite migrations, custom APP_NAME, stable APP_KEY, zero default demo users/Teams, authentication/Teams tests and frontend build without AWS or Redis. This is not an actual GitHub-derived repository.

after_authorized_enablement: Read back is_template=true and confirm Use this template is available for the approved default branch.
Creating an actual derived GitHub repository requires separate explicit owner authorization and an agreed owner/name/visibility; none is created by this proposal.
After that separate authorization, confirm the new repository starts with independent history, preserves README and MIT LICENSE notices, and repeats the issue #48 consumer smoke without AWS or Redis.
update_policy: Repositories generated from this template have independent history. Later template changes are not automatically propagated; consumers review and adopt updates explicitly.
